topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Pattern Recognition Receptor Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses pathogens and damage through molecular patterns and transduces these cues via pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cell Activation, Leukocyte Recruitment, and Systemic Consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how activated sentinel cells direct immune cell extravasation, lymphatic priming, and potential systemic inflammatory pathologies.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the immune system halts active inflammation, restores damaged tissue, and manages persistent insults through chronic inflammation and granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture Closing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic.
